<action type="say">
If the checking account isn’t even showing in the North Shore Community Bank app’s main list, the issue is with how the bank has the account linked, not just with viewing the balance.

Here are quick things to check in the app first (these are safe to try right now):

1) Look for filters or “Show/Hide accounts”
- On the main accounts screen, see if there’s:
  - A “Filter,” “View,” or “Manage accounts” option.
  - A “Hidden/Inactive” or “Closed accounts” section.
- Sometimes checking gets hidden or moved if it’s been inactive or recently changed.

2) Check whether you’re in the right profile
- If you’ve ever had:
  - A business account, or
  - A joint account with someone else,
  there might be tabs like “Personal / Business” or “Profiles” where the checking is under a different view.

3) Think about any recent changes
- Did you:
  - Open this checking account very recently (last 1–2 days)?
  - Close or convert an old account (e.g., to a different type)?
  - Get a new debit card with a different number?
If so, the bank may not have finished linking or migrating it in the app.

If you’ve checked those and still don’t see it, the next step is to contact North Shore Community Bank so they can fix the linkage on their side. When you call or message them, you can say something like:

“I’m logged into the North Shore Community Bank mobile app, but my checking account ending in [last 4 digits] doesn’t appear in my accounts list at all. Can you verify that the account is:
1) Open and active, and  
2) Linked to my online banking profile/username,  
and make sure it’s set to be visible in the mobile app?”

If you tell me:
- Whether this is a personal or joint account, and  
- Roughly when you opened it or last used it,

I can refine what you should ask them or help you draft a very short message to send through their secure chat/email.</action>

<action type="say">
Given this is a long‑standing personal account that you just used a few days ago, it should definitely appear in your app. If it doesn’t, that almost always means a bank‑side issue like:

- The account got detached from your online profile by mistake, or  
- Its status changed (e.g., a security flag, system error, or maintenance) so it’s hidden.

Quick things you can try yourself (takes just a minute or two):
1) Log out of the app completely, then log back in.
2) Make sure the app is updated via the App Store/Play Store.
3) If it’s still missing, try on:
   - A different device, or  
   - Their website in a browser (if you have login there).

If the account is missing everywhere, you’ll need the bank to fix it. When you call or use secure chat with North Shore Community Bank, you can say something like:

“Hi, my personal checking account isn’t appearing in my online banking at all. I’ve had it for years and used the debit card a few days ago.  
Can you please:
1) Confirm the account is open and active,  
2) Confirm it’s correctly linked to my online banking username, and  
3) Re‑enable it so it’s visible in both the mobile app and online banking?  

Right now, I’m unable to see the account or its balance in the app.”

If you’d like, tell me whether you plan to call or use secure messaging, and I can tailor this into a very short script or message you can copy‑paste.</action>
